source: Zhao R, Najmi M, Fiser A, Goldman ID. J Biol Chem 2016;291(15):8162-8172, doi 10.1074/jbc.M115.693929, read from the publisher PDF
template: modified PCFT in which Cys66 and Cys298 are substituted with serine, referred to as DSL

not_studied.reason: both mutations are located in the same helix

readout: cross-linkage decreased the influx Vmax, assessed with methotrexate at 50 micromolar, ten times the influx Kt of wild-type PCFT
substrate_protection: folic acid decreased the CuPh-induced inhibition of transport in the three pairs that reached sufficient inhibition at 1.25 micromolar CuPh
